lessons.theme_focus: Saludos formales e informales, presentación básica con nombre.
learning_objectives: Can greet someone using basic greetings.
Can introduce him/herself using name.

lessons.theme_focus: Preguntar y responder sobre el estado de ánimo y bienestar.
learning_objectives: Can ask how someone is.
Can respond to 'How are you?' using basic expressions.

lessons.title_target: Saying Goodbye and Using Politeness Formulas
lessons.theme_focus: Expresiones de despedida y fórmulas de cortesía básicas.
learning_objectives: Can say goodbye using basic expressions.
Can use basic politeness formulas.

lessons.theme_focus: Números cardinales del 1 al 10 para edad y cantidades básicas.
learning_objectives: Can count from 1 to 10.
Can state his/her age using numbers.

lessons.theme_focus: Números cardinales del 11 al 20 y su uso en contextos simples.
learning_objectives: Can count from 11 to 20.
Can use numbers 11-20 in simple contexts.

lessons.theme_focus: Números del 21 al 100: repaso de twenty y de las unidades, introducción de las decenas y composición de números compuestos (twenty-one, thirty-two, fifty-five). La generación de contenido debe modelar la composición con guion y practicarla en ejemplos, ejercicios y quiz.
learning_objectives: Can count from 21 to 100 using reviewed ones/twenty and new tens, form compound numbers like fifty-five, and state ages using numbers.

lessons.theme_focus: Intercambio de información personal: nombre, edad, origen, residencia.
learning_objectives: Can ask and answer questions about name, age, and origin.
Can state where he/she lives.

lessons.theme_focus: Miembros de la familia inmediata y presentación de los mismos.
learning_objectives: Can name immediate family members.
Can describe his/her immediate family using 'have got'.

lessons.theme_focus: Miembros de la familia extendida y preguntas sobre la familia.
learning_objectives: Can name extended family members.
Can ask and answer questions about family members.

lessons.theme_focus: Nombres de profesiones y cómo hablar del trabajo propio.
learning_objectives: Can name common jobs and occupations.
Can state what he/she does for a living.
grammar_focus: present simple: affirmative (I work as ...) and questions with do (What do you do?)

lessons.theme_focus: Formación de preguntas y respuestas cortas con do/does.
learning_objectives: Can ask yes/no questions using do/does.
Can answer yes/no questions using short answers.

lessons.theme_focus: Formación de oraciones negativas con don't y doesn't.
learning_objectives: Can form negative sentences using don't/doesn't.
Can state what he/she does not do.

lessons.theme_focus: Acciones de la rutina diaria y la hora a la que se realizan.
learning_objectives: Can describe daily routine using present simple.
Can state the time of daily activities.
grammar_focus: present simple: affirmative (I get up at ...)

lessons.theme_focus: Decir la hora en punto y con minutos.
learning_objectives: Can tell the time using o'clock and half past.
Can ask what time it is.

lessons.title_form: Hablar de los días de la semana
lessons.title_target: Talking About the Days of the Week
lessons.theme_focus: Los días de la semana y hablar de qué día es hoy.
learning_objectives: Can name the days of the week.
Can ask and answer what day it is.

lessons.title_form: Hablar de los meses del año
lessons.title_target: Talking About the Months of the Year
lessons.theme_focus: Los doce meses del año y su uso para hablar de fechas
learning_objectives: Can name the months of the year.
Can say in which month an event happens.

lessons.title_target: Talking About Dates, Birthdays, and Ordinal Numbers
lessons.theme_focus: Decir y escribir fechas completas (día, mes y año), hablar del cumpleaños y practicar ordinales hasta thirty-first. La lección debe practicar las formas 'the 21st of July 2026' y 'July 21st, 2026'. La explicación debe presentar el sistema completo de ordinales: first, second y third; cambios de escritura como fifth, eighth, ninth y twelfth; y la regla regular -th. El generador debe incluir los ordinales en la explicación, ejemplos, ejercicios, flashcards y quiz cuando corresponda, sin inventar IDs de lexemas.
learning_objectives: Can say and write a complete date using the day, month, and year, and talk about his/her birthday using ordinal numbers.
Can use ordinal numbers for dates, including first, second, third, fifth, eighth, ninth, twelfth, twentieth, and thirtieth.
Can explain and apply the regular -th pattern and spelling changes to form ordinal dates through thirty-first.
grammar_focus: complete dates: the + ordinal + of + month + year (The 21st of July 2026) and month + ordinal + year (July 21st, 2026)
ordinal numbers for dates: first, second, third, spelling changes in fifth/eighth/ninth/twelfth, and regular -th forms through thirty-first

lessons.theme_focus: Adverbios de frecuencia para describir hábitos.
learning_objectives: Can use adverbs of frequency to describe habits.
Can ask how often someone does something.

lessons.title_form: Transporte y cómo ir al trabajo
lessons.theme_focus: Medios de transporte y cómo llegar al trabajo o escuela.
learning_objectives: Can name common means of transport.
Can state how he/she goes to work or school.

lessons.theme_focus: Describir la rutina de otra persona usando la tercera persona.
learning_objectives: Can describe someone else's daily routine using present simple 3rd person.
Can ask about someone else's routine.
grammar_focus: present simple: 3rd person -s and questions with does (Does he/she ...?)

lessons.theme_focus: Vocabulario de alimentos y bebidas comunes.
learning_objectives: Can name common foods and drinks in simple contexts.
Can identify food and drink items when choosing what to have.
grammar_focus: articles: a/an with countable food items (an apple, a salad)

lessons.theme_focus: Pedir comida y bebida en un restaurante o café.
learning_objectives: Can order food and drinks in a restaurant.
Can ask for the bill.

lessons.theme_focus: Preguntar y decir precios, manejo de dinero.
learning_objectives: Can ask how much something costs.
Can state the price of an item.

lessons.theme_focus: Uso de some y any con sustantivos contables e incontables.
learning_objectives: Can use 'some' and 'any' with countable and uncountable nouns.
Can ask for things using 'some' and 'any'.

lessons.theme_focus: Verbos de acción de alta frecuencia para describir actividades.
learning_objectives: Can use common action verbs in present simple.
Can describe simple actions.

lessons.theme_focus: Dar instrucciones simples usando el imperativo afirmativo y negativo.
learning_objectives: Can give simple instructions using imperatives.
Can follow simple instructions.

lessons.theme_focus: Nombres de lugares comunes en una ciudad.
learning_objectives: Can name common places in a town.
Can ask where a place is.

lessons.theme_focus: Preposiciones de lugar para describir la ubicación de objetos y lugares.
learning_objectives: Can use prepositions of place to describe location.
Can describe where objects are.
grammar_focus: there is/there are: affirmative with prepositions

lessons.theme_focus: Pedir y dar direcciones simples usando lugares, verbos de movimiento y expresiones de dirección.
learning_objectives: Can ask for directions to a place.
Can give simple directions.
grammar_focus: imperative: affirmative for directions (Go straight/Turn left)

lessons.title_form: En el hotel y la casa
lessons.title_target: Checking into a Hotel and Describing a Home
lessons.theme_focus: Vocabulario y frases para registrarse en un hotel y describir espacios y objetos básicos de una casa.
learning_objectives: Can check into a hotel using basic expressions.
Can ask for the key and breakfast time.
Can identify common rooms and household objects.

lessons.title_target: Describing a Town with There Is/Are
lessons.theme_focus: Describir qué hay en una ciudad usando there is/are.
learning_objectives: Can describe what there is in a town using 'there is/there are'.
Can ask if there is a place near here.
grammar_focus: there is/there are: affirmative descriptions and questions (Is there ...?)

lessons.theme_focus: Identificar animales y describir paisajes naturales sencillos.
learning_objectives: Can identify and name common animals and natural places.
Can describe a simple natural scene using there is/there are and basic adjectives.
grammar_focus: there is/there are: affirmative descriptions with prepositions of place

lessons.title_target: Talking About Hobbies and Free Time
lessons.theme_focus: Actividades de tiempo libre y pasatiempos.
learning_objectives: Can name common hobbies and free time activities.
Can talk about what he/she does in free time.
grammar_focus: like + noun: affirmative (I like football); distinguish noun objects from -ing activity forms

lessons.theme_focus: Expresar gustos y preferencias con like, love, hate.
learning_objectives: Can express likes and dislikes using like/love/hate.
Can ask someone about their likes.
grammar_focus: like + -ing: affirmative (I like reading) and questions (Do you like ...?)

lessons.theme_focus: Preguntar y responder sobre gustos y preferencias.
learning_objectives: Can ask yes/no questions about likes.
Can answer yes/no questions about likes using short answers.
grammar_focus: present simple: yes/no questions with do/does

lessons.title_target: Talking About Future Plans with Going To
lessons.theme_focus: Expresar planes futuros inmediatos usando going to.
learning_objectives: Can talk about future plans using going to.
Can use going to for simple plans and will for simple predictions.

lessons.theme_focus: Expresar deseos y necesidades usando want to.
learning_objectives: Can express wishes using 'want to'.
Can ask about someone's wishes.
grammar_focus: want + infinitive: affirmative (I want to ...) and questions (Do you want to ...?)

lessons.theme_focus: Partes del cuerpo humano.
learning_objectives: Can name basic parts of the body.
Can point to and name body parts.
grammar_focus: plural nouns: regular and irregular (foot/feet, tooth/teeth)

lessons.theme_focus: Describir síntomas y problemas de salud comunes.
learning_objectives: Can describe common symptoms using 'I have'.
Can say where it hurts.
grammar_focus: have: affirmative with symptoms (I have a headache)

lessons.theme_focus: Adjetivos para expresar emociones y estados de ánimo.
learning_objectives: Can express basic emotions and states.
Can ask how someone feels.
grammar_focus: present simple: be with adjectives (I'm happy)

lessons.theme_focus: Expresar habilidad y permiso usando can y can't.
learning_objectives: Can talk about abilities using 'can' and 'can't'.
Can ask for permission using 'can'.

lessons.theme_focus: Colores y adjetivos para describir la apariencia física.
learning_objectives: Can name basic colors.
Can describe physical appearance using basic adjectives.
grammar_focus: present simple: be with adjectives (It's red)

lessons.theme_focus: Prendas de vestir y colores.
learning_objectives: Can name common items of clothing.
Can describe what someone is wearing.

lessons.theme_focus: Comprar ropa: preguntar precio, talla y probarse.
learning_objectives: Can ask the price of an item of clothing.
Can ask to try on clothes.
grammar_focus: wh-questions: how much with be (How much is it?)

lessons.theme_focus: Pedir ayuda y preguntar por artículos cotidianos en una tienda.
learning_objectives: Can ask for help in a store.
Can ask if a store has an item.
grammar_focus: present simple: questions with do/does (Do you have ...?)

lessons.theme_focus: Pedir ayuda y describir situaciones de emergencia.
learning_objectives: Can name basic services and emergency contacts.
Can ask for help in an emergency.

lessons.theme_focus: Vocabulario del clima y cómo describir el tiempo.
learning_objectives: Can describe the weather using basic adjectives.
Can ask what the weather is like.
grammar_focus: present simple: be with weather adjectives (It's sunny)

lessons.theme_focus: Estaciones del año y actividades asociadas.
learning_objectives: Can name the four seasons.
Can talk about activities in different seasons.

lessons.theme_focus: Vocabulario de viajes y vacaciones.
learning_objectives: Can talk about travel and vacations using basic vocabulary.
Can describe simple travel plans using going to.
grammar_focus: going to future: travel plans (I'm going to ...)

lessons.theme_focus: Conectores básicos para unir ideas y adverbios frecuentes para añadir, intensificar o matizar mensajes: and, but, or, because, so, also, too, very, really, just, maybe. El generador debe practicar estas palabras con el vocabulario complementario de gustos, opiniones y emociones para producir ejemplos y ejercicios comunicativos variados.
learning_objectives: Can use basic connectors and common adverbs to join, add, intensify, or modify simple ideas.
Can express reason using 'because'.

lessons.theme_focus: Repaso integral de presentación personal: nombre, edad, origen, familia, trabajo.
learning_objectives: Can present him/herself using personal information, family and work vocabulary.
Can answer simple questions about personal information.
grammar_focus: present simple: review (be, have got, common verbs)

lessons.theme_focus: Repaso de rutinas diarias, hora, gustos y tiempo libre.
learning_objectives: Can describe daily routines and free time activities.
Can talk about likes and dislikes.

lessons.theme_focus: Repasar el vocabulario de rutinas y tiempo libre.
learning_objectives: Can review vocabulary related to routines and free time.
Can use previously learned vocabulary in simple present sentences.

lessons.theme_focus: Repaso de compras, restaurante y direcciones; la salud se trabajará con más profundidad en la siguiente lección.
learning_objectives: Can handle basic transactions in shops and restaurants.
Can ask for and give directions.

lessons.theme_focus: Repasar síntomas de salud y direcciones en situaciones cotidianas, como continuación especializada de la lección 054.
learning_objectives: Can describe basic health symptoms and ask for simple help.
Can review directions and use health vocabulary in simple sentences.
